# Family Expense Tracker

> A household finance app for families to log shared expenses, import bank statements, track recurring bills and trips, set budgets, and settle up twice a month.

Family Expense Tracker is a private, account-based web and Android app. Members join a family workspace, record expenses with categories, payment accounts, receipts, and reimbursement status, and review spending through charts, budgets, and weekly email reports. Most pages require signing in.

## Pages

- [Sign in](/auth): Create an account or sign in to your family workspace.

## Optional

- [Home](/): Redirects signed-in members to their dashboard.
